scope: Validate loaded Terraria Mobile IL2CPP method, Vector2 and netMode contracts before enabling collision detours
runtimeAuthority: Terraria Mobile 1.4.5.8.6 build 301720; not tModLoader desktop ABI

reference.vector: Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Vector2; value size 8; instance System.Single X/Y at normalized offsets 0/4
methods: instance void Projectile.GetCollisionParams(out Vector2 resizeAnchor, out int colWidth, out int colHeight)
reference.binding: Names/types/layout are validated from loaded metadata; no dump RVA or game object offset is hardcoded.

checks.name: Production Mobile collision metadata validator fixture
Production ManagedProjectileHook.cpp translation unit syntax check
Native bind, descriptor, collision policy, geometry, Mobile ABI and SourceParser executables
Managed entity lifecycle including upstream deferred collision responses

rejections: Static/generic/wrong-owner methods and non-void return types
Missing metadata exports and wrong parameter counts/types/by-reference markers
UnityEngine.Vector2 instead of the Mobile XNA type
Wrong value type/size, field types/names/order/bounds or extra instance fields
netMode instance storage, wrong type/width/value kind, missing field or missing static-read export
limits: Fixtures execute production validators against fake metadata, not against a running Android process.
Typed fields do not prove runtime semantics; the observed dump is static evidence.
Android ARM64 CI must be consulted at the new published commit; local toolchain only performed host syntax checks.
Android gameplay, physics, performance, multiplayer and synchronous dynamic callback completeness remain unvalidated.
Recent deferred collision-response commits are preserved; these responses remain a next-tick contract.
